sources.en:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User
    participant App as App
    participant API as Server
    User->>App: Submit request
    App->>+API: Validate and process
    Note over App,API: Native messages, activations and branches
    alt Valid request
        API-->>App: Return result
    else Invalid request
        API-->>App: Return error
    end
    deactivate API
    App-->>User: Show response
sources.zh:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as 用户
    participant App as 应用
    participant API as 服务端
    User->>App: 提交请求
    App->>+API: 校验并处理
    Note over App,API: 原生消息、激活与分支
    alt 请求有效
        API-->>App: 返回结果
    else 请求无效
        API-->>App: 返回错误
    end
    deactivate API
    App-->>User: 展示响应
